source: COHORT-WEEK8.md, read 2026-11-03 9:47 PM ET. Aggregate rates only; no player names. Baseline numbers and names match Team Blue's harness (teams/blue/sim/crews-sim.mjs).

A1_found_uplift.what: A Squad card on Home doubles the rate players start a group, against the first-share stamp rate (0.054 per entrant-week). Off: founding at the cohort's first-share rate.

A2_friends_pulled.what: A founder asks a mean of 1.5 players already in the Field to join (18 of the 33 Week 8 entrants came in through a friend). Off: a Squad grows only through new signups.

A3_invite_lift.what: Squad members with an open seat bring a signup at 1.5x the cohort rate (0.04 per entrant-week). The multiplier era (W5 to W8) only moved it from 0.040 to 0.044, so this is the weakest assumption. Off: cohort rate.

A4_retention_proxy.what: A member of a live Squad returns like a loser who reloaded: +10 points after a loss (0.86 against 0.76, Reload being the cohort's only measured reason to stay), +3 after a win. Off: cohort return rates.

A5_nudge_reactivation.what: An absent member of a live Squad comes back at 0.30 a week when squadmates nudge (cohort reactivation 0.18, higher for recent absentees; real-player nudges so far: 0). Off: 0.18.

A6_link_confirm.what: Founder rule: a referral or a Squad seat counts only when both sides confirm with one tap. 0.8 of links get both taps (the cohort has 1 referral claim, unclaimed, so there is no rate). Unconfirmed referred signups still play, but credit no multiplier and take no seat. Shown at 0.5 too.
